scores.rationale: Phases run substrate, guardrails, triage, resolution, widening, and each phase unlocks only after its gate passes. The dependency map makes this explicit.

scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end production slice with deploy, rollback and alerts. It is dry run, but it runs through every tier.

scores.evidence: Autonomy and trust boundary | R3 ... Default ... Flip condition: Auto-merge is considered only after V5 plus months of measured history.
scores.rationale: The irreversible decisions are listed with reversibility, default, assumption, validation and flip condition. Assumptions are labeled.

scores.evidence: Tasks, widest blast radius first: 1. Tool executor with a tool allow-list...
scores.rationale: Phase 1 is explicitly ordered by blast radius, and Phase 2 starts with the schema as the widest rework. Phase 3's task order is less explicit.

scores.evidence: Webhook signature check; least-privilege App; secrets in a secret manager; dry run only; untrusted text fenced
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security treatment in every phase from Phase 0 on.

scores.evidence: OpenTelemetry trace per issue from webhook to model call... Alerts on queue age, error rate, and the daily cost cap.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 has concrete observability, and each later phase extends it with specific metrics.

scores.evidence: IaC (Terraform), pinned image, pinned model and prompt versions
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is concrete in every phase, covering IaC, pins, versioned eval sets and hash-locked sandbox images.

scores.evidence: Kill switch; previous-image rollback; idempotent processing by delivery ID
scores.rationale: Resilience appears concretely in every phase, including kill switches, fallbacks, retries and rollbacks.

scores.evidence: Guardrail defense, cost budget and HITL in Phase 1, then retrieval (Phase 2), model access, memory and orchestration (Phase 3), routing and feedback (Phase 4)
scores.rationale: Defenses, budgets and human-in-the-loop come before capabilities, and the later layers follow the required order. One wrinkle: memory is listed in Phase 3 alongside orchestration.

scores.evidence: Auto-merge of agent PRs: pulled forward only after a sustained V5 history, an explicit risk acceptance by the repo owner, and a fresh V2/V3 run.
scores.rationale: Each deferred item has an explicit pull-forward condition.

note: This is a strong plan. It has a real production walking skeleton, guardrails before capabilities, threaded cross-cutting concerns, explicit gates and deferrals, and only minor ordering quibbles.
